messages:
Maya: Quick brief  Need landing hero + 3 benchmark micro-tiles + compact SDR routing graphic for next week's launch. Final assets Fri EOD.
Ethan: Got it. What metrics for the tiles?
Maya: Hosted p50=86ms cost=$0.0024; Dedicated p50=63ms cost=$0.00155; Private p50=71ms cost=$0.00205. Highlight: Dedicated = most cost-efficient at scale.
Priya: Brand constraints: use updated tokens (navy, coral, sage), Inter type, flat 2-color icons. Tiles max 3 metrics + 1-line insight.
Miles: Routing: score >= 60 -> SDR queue + Slack alert (#sdr-high); <60 -> 7-day nurture. Use a tiny legend, color-coded paths.
Maya: Deliverables: Figma file with pages (hero, tiles, routing), PNG exports 1200x628, 640x360, 1920x1080. Include localizable text layers for en-US/en-GB.
Priya: Legal check: avoid words like "cheapest". Use "most cost-efficient at scale" and footnote: "Based on internal Redwood performance tests, June 2025." I'll sign off Thu.
Ethan: CTAs: Hero = "Register for benchmark webinar"; Tiles small link = "Read full benchmark". Add UTM placeholder utm_campaign=cohort_q3.
Maya: Small ask: add a corner badge on benchmark tiles for "automatic fallback" (icon + short text).
design-bot: Checklist added: [Figma master, PNG 1200x628, PNG 640x360, PNG 1920x1080, SVG icons, localizable text layers, export manifest].
Maya: First drafts by Thu noon, final Fri EOD. Please comment in Figma not Slack.
Priya: I'll do brand sweep Thu evening and confirm legal copy.
Miles: Noted for paid channel timing  need final by Mon AM for scheduling.
Maya: Thanks everyone :rocket:
